definitions.full: H5610. sephar I. סְפָר noun [masculine] enumeration, census (late; on formative compare Lag BN 175 ); — absolute ׳ס , followed by אֲשֶׁר as accusative of congnate meaning with verb סָפַר 2Chr 2:16 .
